forbidden.name: game-is-pure
forbidden.comment: src/game holds the rules of the game: plain TypeScript that imports nothing outside src/game, no framework, database or network. Its tests may import vitest.

forbidden.name: web-talks-to-the-server-over-http
forbidden.comment: The page never imports server or database code, so a day's answers can never be bundled into the browser.

forbidden.name: adapters-do-not-know-the-server
forbidden.comment: Adapters talk to the outside world (the database) and implement the ports src/game defines; they never reach into the HTTP layer or the page.

forbidden.name: server-does-not-import-the-page
forbidden.comment: The HTTP layer wires the rules to the adapters; the page is a separate program.
